radius.$description: Corner radius of the Dialog panel.

padding.$description: Internal padding of the Dialog panel.

gap.$description: Gap between dialog title, body, and action rows.

sm.$description: Maximum inline size of size='sm' dialogs (8x the md control height; 320px at the default brand).

md.$description: Maximum inline size of size='md' dialogs (12x the md control height; 480px at the default brand).

lg.$description: Maximum inline size of size='lg' dialogs (16x the md control height; 640px at the default brand).

backdrop.$description: Base color of the modal backdrop behind the Dialog; the component applies dialog.backdrop-opacity on top of it.

backdrop-opacity.$description: Percentage opacity applied to dialog.backdrop inside the backdrop color-mix(). The semantic vocabulary has no opacity category yet, so this is a component-tier literal.

z.$description: Stacking layer of the Dialog and its backdrop.
